scripts.start:
npm run indicator & npx serve . > server.log 2>&1 & echo Server started && echo Access: http://localhost:33000 && echo 
Use 'npm stop' to stop the server
scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$pids = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 33000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); if ($pids) { foreach ($procId in $pids) { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Server stopped'; } else { Write-Output 'Server not running'; }"
